status: experimental portability/security architecture; no production promotion
purpose: Move contracts, capsules, verifier bundles, policy profiles, evidence, and other trust-relevant artifacts between connected, intermittently connected, and air-gapped environments without treating provenance, signatures, witnesses, or successful import as authority.
package_properties: one or more verified signatures over the manifest
optional independent witness or transparency evidence
explicit package expiry and maximum import age
mandatory local review and fresh policy check before activation
import_pipeline: verify signer identities and signature profiles
resolve local trust and policy requirements
surface diffs, conflicts, stale dependencies, and privilege changes
install or activate only the admitted subset
air_gap_rules: removable-media or courier transport is treated as untrusted ingress
no autorun or executable interpretation during transfer validation
transfer workstation should be lower-trust than protected enclave where feasible
evidence may cross through one-way or separately governed export paths
return-channel artifacts receive the same quarantine process
revocation/currentness unavailable across the air gap remains explicitly stale
nonclaims: This profile does not prescribe a ZIP/TAR/container format.
This profile does not define a new digital signature algorithm.
Witnesses improve evidence but do not mint local authority.
A valid package can still contain malicious or inappropriate content.
